newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end higher on dollar, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end higher on dollar, Wall Street.

text.p: Swiss shares ended higher as a rising dollar and gains on Wall Street boosted share prices. Book-squaring ahead of year-end also helped push up the bourse, but the volume was thin, dealers said.
The SMI index of leading shares ended 52.4 points or 1.35 percent higher at 3,922.2 points. Some short-covering was seen after the SMI Index jumped over the 3,900 points, a dealer said.
The broad SPI firmed 28.39 points 2,501.08 points.
Roche registered shares jumped 300 francs to 10,435 francs, after setting a new all-time high of 10,440 francs. Novartis registereds rose 24 francs to 1,509 francs.
Other industrial stocks were also sharply higher, including ABB, Holderbank, Sulzer and Georg Fischer and SMH.
Most financials also firmed, while CS closed unchanged at 137.25 francs. Elektrowatt also was unchanged and ended at 534.
One of the losers was Phonak, shedding 35 francs to 1,065. Kuoni and Moevenpick also were lower.
